name: @rede-social/module-chat
description: Chat module (CHAT-01..05): the member <-> support conversation. Owns the chat tables (moved from the Phase 1 stub and reshaped: per-conversation counters, a gapless seq assigned by a trigger under the conversation row lock, the shared staff read seq, the author side, the body CHECK and participant/staff-aware policies), the ids-only Realtime signals published by a definer trigger, the lazy member send, the staff reply, the seq catch-up reads, the staff inbox, the chat badges and the push-only support source.
